Review: More Coffee Please
Reviewer: James Faure
October 8
Rating: *****
More Coffee Please opened only a few years ago, and their business has grown
quickly. It is easy to see why. Their Decca coffee grinder is the best ever. I am
very particular about my coffee and have used electric coffee grinders that were
more expensive than this one. With the Decca grinder, whatever setting I use,
the grinds are perfectly consistent. Also, their decaffeinated coffee is rich and
flavorful. On top of that, their dancing beans mug looks great. Many at my office
admire it. Everything they sell is worth a try.
